english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for describing something in terms of its population characteristics.

examples.english: Demographically, this neighbourhood is mainly made up of young families.
examples.traditional: 以人口特徵嚟講，呢區嘅住戶以年輕家庭為主。
